description: In any arithmetic structure, the specified totality-and-uniqueness sentence holds exactly when every input tuple has exactly one output satisfying the graph.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.realize_totalUnique.{u} {n : ℕ} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  (φ : Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula (Fin n ⊕ Unit)) :
  M ⊨ Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.totalUnique φ ↔
    ∀ (x : Fin n → M), ∃! y, φ.Realize (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.extend x y)
